# Marimo Studio 0.2.1

Marimo Studio 0.2.1 adds a terminal workflow for pairing coding agents with
live notebooks and a showcase of the views built from its examples.

## Pair coding agents with notebooks

- The [`marimo pair` CLI](https://marimo.io/pair) lists local notebook servers
  and runs Python in their kernels. Local discovery finds servers started with
  `--no-token`. Give an agent the URL and token file to connect to a protected
  server.
- `uvx --with marimo-studio agent-plugins read marimo-studio` gives an agent
  the instructions shipped with the installed Studio version. [`uvx`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)
  comes with uv.
- A single prompt can start a notebook for a new topic or target an existing notebook.

## Browse the examples

The README and documentation landing page show each example notebook alongside
its views. Select a view poster on the docs site to open that example with the
view selected.

## Compatibility

Marimo Studio 0.2.1 supports Python 3.10 through 3.14 and
[Marimo](https://marimo.io/) 0.25.0. The `deno` extra provides
[Deno](https://docs.deno.com/) 2.9.5 or newer for [React](https://react.dev/),
[Reveal.js](https://revealjs.com/), [Svelte](https://svelte.dev/), and
[Observable Notebook Kit](https://observablehq.com/notebook-kit/kit) authoring.
The `lens` extra requires
[marimo-lens](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-lens) 0.2.2 or newer.

[All changes since 0.2.0](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-studio/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1)
